subject: MPA draft and compliance checklist for Peregrine Logistics — post-call alignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@peregrine.logistics>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPA draft and compliance checklist for Peregrine Logistics — post-call alignment

Hi Alicia / Carlos,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the candid breakdown of the latency and cost pressure on your edge routing system. Quick recap so we have shared expectations and an MPA skeleton to iterate on.

Key pain points you called out:
- Peak inference latency spikes on low-bandwidth links (3–4s tail latency for short prompts).
- Per-token inference spend across 3k daily calls is unsustainable at current model settings.
- Internal compliance: retention windows and tenant isolation for ETA-sensitive PII.

Primary goals we heard:
1) Reduce 95th percentile latency to <800ms for common prompt patterns.
2) Cut per-token cost by at least 40% during the pilot (through batching + quantized model).
3) Prove end-to-end telemetry and retention policy for audit (SOC2 scope).

Proposed milestones (draft MPA — attached as Peregrine_MPA_v1.xlsx):
- Milestone A (Pilot kickoff): environments provisioned + test dataset ingestion — target Sep 7, owner: Peregrine (Carlos) + Redwood (Ben)
- Milestone B (Performance tuning): kernel/quantization experiments + baseline report — target Sep 21, owner: Redwood (Ben)
- Milestone C (Security & retention sign-off): SOC2 evidence + retention config validated — target Sep 28, owner: Peregrine (Alicia) + Redwood (Monica)
- Milestone D (Pilot close / decision): results review + commercial decision — target Oct 5, owner: Peregrine exec sponsor

Open questions / asks from our side:
- Please confirm procurement contact and preferred contract cadence (SOW or MSA + statement).
- Any existing retention windows/policy docs you can share so Monica can map required controls?
- A short sample of representative prompts (anonymized) to calibrate performance runs.

Attachments: Peregrine_MPA_v1.xlsx (MPA draft), SOC2_summary.pdf (Redwood SOC2 scope), pilot_scope.pdf (proposed pilot acceptance criteria).

Next step I propose: I’ll upload the MPA to the Drive and Ben will schedule a 45-min technical kickoff next week. If that works, please confirm owners for Milestone A and we’ll lock dates.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@peregrine.logistics>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@peregrine.logistics>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MPA draft and compliance checklist for Peregrine Logistics — post-call alignment

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear summary. This matches our internal notes. A few quick items: 

1) Procurement contact: please loop in Carlos (c.mendez@peregrine.logistics) for contract cadence — we typically prefer an MSA + SOW for pilots.
2) SOC2 / compliance: I don’t have the full SOC2 cert to share externally yet; I will coordinate with our internal security lead about retention policy docs. We need Redwood to confirm whether audit logs can be exported on our schedule (14/30/90 days).
3) Sample prompts: I’ll attach an anonymized batch of 20 prompts by EOD Thu — they are safe to use for tuning.

Milestone owners: I can be the internal sponsor for Milestone C (security sign-off); Carlos will be the procurement owner for Milestone A.

One additional ask: can Redwood confirm an expected monthly token budget for the pilot given the 40% cost target? That helps us size internal approvals.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Torres
Head of Product Innovation | Peregrine Logistics
alicia.torres@peregrine.logistics

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@peregrine.logistics>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@peregrine.logistics>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA draft and compliance checklist for Peregrine Logistics — post-call alignment

Alicia / team — appreciate the clarity. Quick answers from ops/pricing: 

- Pilot sizing: based on the 3k daily calls and our tuning assumptions, estimated monthly token volume is ~9M tokens. To hit ~40% unit-cost reduction we’ll assume an optimized small-medium quantized model + autoscaling; I’ll include a cost snapshot in the kickoff.
- Procurement: MSA + SOW is fine. For pilot discount we can offer a 30% committed pilot credit if Peregrine signs the SOW covering the 8-week pilot window (Sep 7–Oct 5).

Action items I’ll take before kickoff:
- Prepare a short runbook for network/ingress settings for the low-bandwidth sites.
- Share a preliminary cost projection and the benchmark plan (by Sep 1).

One operational note: Alicia, if you expect strict retention windows (14 days), we may need to toggle our cache TTLs during the pilot — Monica, I’ll sync with you on the audit-export hook.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0182

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Thanks all — short update and confirmed owners + next steps to lock the MPA: 

Confirmed owners / dates:
- Milestone A (Pilot kickoff, env + dataset): Carlos Mendez (Peregrine) + Ben Carter (Redwood) — target Sep 7.
- Milestone B (Perf tuning & benchmark): Ben Carter (Redwood) — target Sep 21.
- Milestone C (Security & retention sign-off): Alicia Torres (Peregrine) + Monica Patel (Redwood) — target Sep 28.
- Milestone D (Pilot close / decision): Peregrine exec sponsor — Oct 5 review.

Attachments pushed to Drive: Peregrine_MPA_v1.xlsx (MPA draft), SOC2_summary.pdf (Redwood SOC2 highlights), pilot_scope.pdf (acceptance criteria). I also created a HubSpot deal with the MPA link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/112233/PL-2026-07-91

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Carlos: confirm procurement timeline and sign-off owner to receive the SOW (Carlos replied he will confirm by EOD Mon).
- Alicia: please upload the anonymized prompts to the Drive so Ben can include them in baseline runs.
- Ben: deliver the benchmark plan + cost snapshot by Sep 1.
- Monica: confirm audit-export cadence options and whether 14-day TTL can be supported in pilot mode.

I’ll update the MPA with the confirmed dates and send a short calendar invite for the technical kickoff (45 min) for Sep 8 (buffer in case Carlos needs to finalize procurement). If anyone needs different dates, speak up now.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Soojin
